items.evidence: Rust NBT writer emits "sound_variant": "minecraft:classic" on cows/pigs/chickens/cats (entity_nbt.rs:872-880) — a tag vanilla 1.21.7 never writes for them (only wolves have sound variants in 1.21.7 data). Ignored on load; harmless. Sounds are correct.
items.title: NBT sound_variant written on non-wolf mobs (item 682) — accepted note

items.evidence: The special-foil decal (compasses/clocks, 0.5x GUI / 0.75x first person) is not modelled; the GUI sink draws the glint over the full quad. Only visible on a command-enchanted compass/clock. Pre-existing in both versions, not a version delta.
items.title: Special-foil decal not modelled (item 534) — accepted note

items.evidence: The Rust ignores the separator field of nbt components (always ", ") and resolves a title/tellraw component ONCE for all players (vanilla resolves PER PLAYER). Gaps from BOTH versions equally, not version deltas.
items.title: NBT separator ignored + per-player resolution (item 512) — accepted notes
